source: ESMA SFTR counterparty and TR data exchange 2023 (auth.052 1.2.0) and validation rules (ESMA74-362-1008)

fields.name: Action type
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indicates whether transaction is reported for the first time.
fields.rule:
This field shall contain only one of the following values: 'NEWT', 'MODI', VALU', 'COLU', 'EROR', 'CORR', 'ETRM' or ' POSC'. 4 alphabetical characters.
The first report received for given UTI and pair of counterparties shall only contain value "NEWT" or "POSC" in this field. If the first report for a given UTI and pair of counterparties is with action types "MODI", "VALU", "COLU", "EROR", "CORR"  or "ETRM" it shall be rejected.
Only one report with the action type "NEWT" for a given combination of Counterparty ID- ID of the other counterparty-Trade ID  shall be accepted. 
After a report with action type "EROR" is submitted, the only allowed action type to be submitted by the other counterparty, if reporting to the same TR, is "EROR". No additional reports shall be allowed for that UTI. 
The action types ETRM and POSC can only be reported once for a given UTI and pair of counterparties

fields.name: Reporting timestamp
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Date and time of submission of the report to the trade repository.
fields.rule:
This fiield shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:MM:SSZ '-
The reporting timestamp should be equal or earlier than the timestamp of the receipt of the report by the TR. The date part of the timestamp cannot be earlier than the day preceding the date of the receipt of the report by the TR.
The receipt of the report should be understood as the moment the report enters a TR’s system

fields.name: Report submitting entity
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unique code identifying the entity which submits the report. In the case where submission of the report has been delegated to a third party or to the other counterparty, a unique code identifying that entity.
fields.rule:
For action types 'NEWT', 'MODI', 'VALU', 'COLU','ETRM', 'CORR', or ' POSC'.": This field shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued", "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival". The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch.
For action type EROR: This field shall contain an LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit, irrespective of the registration status of that LEI.

fields.name: Reporting counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the counterparty in the transaction.
fields.rule:
For action types 'NEWT', 'MODI', 'VALU', 'COLU', 'CORR', or ' POSC'. This field shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit.  The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch. 
The status of the LEI for all the above action types shall be "Issued", "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival" and in addition for action type "ETRM": the status of the LEI could also  be "Lapsed" and "Retired".
For action type "EROR": This field shall contain an LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit, irrespective of the registration status of that LEI.

fields.name: Nature of the reporting counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Nature of the reporting counterparty in accordance with the local regulation.
fields.rule: Shall contain only one of the following values: "F" or "N".

fields.name: Sector of the reporting counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Classification of the business activities of the reporting counterparty.
fields.rule:
If field 4 is populated with "F", at least one code pertaining to the classification of the financial counterparties shall be provided.
If field 4 is populated with "N", at least one code pertaining to the classification of the non-financial counterparties shall be provided.

fields.name: Additional sector classification
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR - C, ETRM - C, POSC C, COLU - C, CORR C, VALU - C (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Nature business activities of the reporting counterparty as an investment fund.
fields.rule:
If field 5 is populated with 'UCIT', 'AIFD', 'K' or 'L', this field shall be populated and shall contain only one of the following values: 'ETFT', 'MMFT', REIT' or ' OTHR'. 4 alphabetical characters.
Otherwise, it shall be left bank.

fields.name: Sector of the reporting counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Classification of the business activities of the reporting counterparty.
fields.rule:
If field 4 is populated with "F", at least one code pertaining to the classification of the financial counterparties shall be provided.
If field 4 is populated with "N", at least one code pertaining to the classification of the non-financial counterparties shall be provided.

fields.name: Additional sector classification
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR - C, ETRM - C, POSC C, COLU - C, CORR C, VALU - C (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Nature business activities of the reporting counterparty as an investment fund.
fields.rule:
If field 5 is populated with 'UCIT', 'AIFD', 'K' or 'L', this field shall be populated and shall contain only one of the following values: 'ETFT', 'MMFT', REIT' or ' OTHR'. 4 alphabetical characters.
Otherwise, it shall be left bank.

fields.name: Branch of the reporting counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU O, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the branch of the counterparty, when the transaction concludes a transaction through a branch office.
fields.rule: When populated, shall contain a valid ISO 3166 country code,  2 alphabetical characters.

fields.name: Counterparty side
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identifies whether the reporting counterparty is a collateral provider or a collateral taker.
fields.rule: This field shall contain only one of the following values: "TAKE" or "GIVE", " 4 alphabetical characters.

fields.name: Other counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the counterparty in the transaction.
fields.rule:
This field shall contain
- a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch. The LEI shall not pertain to a member of the European System of Central Banks (ESCB). For action types "NEWT", "MODI", "ETRM", "CORR", "COLU", "VALU" and "POSC": The status of the LEI shall be "Issued", "Lapsed", "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival" and in addition for action type "ETRM" the status of the LEI could also  be "Retired".
For action type "EROR": This field shall contain an LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit, irrespective of the registration status of that LEI.
or
-up to 50 alphanumerical characters

fields.name: Branch of the other counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU O, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the branch of the counterparty, when the transaction concludes a transaction through a branch office.
fields.rule: When populated, shall contain a valid ISO 3166 country code,  2 alphabetical characters.

fields.name: Country of the other Counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Country where the registered office of the counterparty is located or country of residence in case that the counterparty is a natural person.
fields.rule:
2 alphabetical characters.
If field 11  is populated with a valid LEI, then the country code provided in this field shall pertain to the country of the registered office of the other counterparty as specified in the LEI reference data.         In case that the other counterparty is a natural person, the code of the country of residence.

fields.name: Entity responsible for the report
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: In the case where a financial counterparty is responsible for reporting on behalf of the other counterparty, the unique code identifying that counterparty. In the case where a management company is responsible for reporting on behalf of an Undertaking for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS), the unique code identifying that management company. In the case where an Alternative Investment Fund Manager (AIFM) is responsible for reporting on behalf of an Alternative Investment Fund (AIF), the unique code identifying that AIFM.
fields.rule:
This field shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch. 
The status of the LEI for all the above action types shall be "Issued", "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival" and in addition for action types "ETRM" and "EROR": the status of the LEI could also  be "Lapsed" and "Retired".

fields.name: Beneficiary
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU -, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the beneficiary who is subject to the rights and obligations arising from the contract.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall contain:
- a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued", 'Lapsed', "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch.
or
-up to 50 alphanumerical characters where any character is allowed.

fields.name: Tri-party agent
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU O, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the third party that administers the transaction.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued",  'Lapsed', "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch.

fields.name: Broker
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU -, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the broker involved in the securities lending transaction.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued",  'Lapsed', "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch.

fields.name: Clearing member
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the clearing member in the case where the trade is cleared.
fields.rule:
If field 2.5 is populated with 'true'  this field shall be populated
When populated, shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued", "Lapsed", "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch.
If field 2.5 is populated with 'false', this field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Central Securities Depository (‘CSD’) participant or indirect participant
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU -, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the parties settling the contract on behalf of the deliverer or receiver.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued",  'Lapsed', "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch

fields.name: Agent lender
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU O, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the agent lender involved in the securities lending transaction.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued",  'Lapsed', "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch

fields.name: Type of SFT
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Details of the repurchase trade transaction.
fields.rule: When populated, shall contain only one of the following values: "SLEB" , 'SBSC', 'REPO' or "MGLD", " 4 alphabetical character.

fields.name: Unique Transaction Identifier ('UTI')
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU O, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unique Trade Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.
fields.rule:
For Repo, BSB and SL when action type = COLU, this field shall be populated when 2.73 = 'false'.
When populated, this field shall contain up to 52 alphanumerical characters. 
Only upper-case alphabetic characters A–Z and the digits 0–9, inclusive in both cases, are allowed
Not allowed to change the content of this field once it is reported. 
The uniqueness of the Trade ID shall be preserved at counterparties level, i.e. the combination of the fields Counterparty ID- ID of the other counterparty-Trade ID shall be unique.

fields.name: Event date
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Date on which the reportable event pertaining to the transaction and captured by the report took place.
fields.rule:
This field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DD.
The date populated in this field shall be:
- prior or equal to the date part of the reporting timestamp
- greater than or equal to the date part of the execution timestamp.
-prior  or equal to the value of the field maturity date or, where populated, the termination date

fields.name: Execution timestamp
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indicates the date and time when the contract was executed.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

fields.name: Cleared
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indicates that the contract has been cleared.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall contain one of the values: 'true' or 'false'

fields.name: CCP
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: In the case of a contract that has been cleared, the unique code for the clearing counterparty that has cleared the contract.
fields.rule:
If field 2.5 is populated with 'true' this field shall be populated with a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued", "Lapsed",  "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch.
If field 2.5 is populated with "false", this field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Clearing timestamp
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Time and date when clearing took place.
fields.rule:
If field 2.5 is populated with 'true' this field shall be populated in a common input format:  YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. 
The value of this field shall be greater than or equal to the value of the field 2.12.
If field 2.5 is populated with "false", this field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Report tracking number
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unique number to indicate a group of reports which relate to the same execution.
fields.rule:
If field 2.5 is populated with 'true' and field 1.3 Reporting Counterparty is different from the field 2.7 CCP, this field shall be populated
When populated, this field shall contain up to 52 alphanumerical characters. 
Only upper-case alphabetic characters A–Z and the digits 0–9, inclusive in both cases, are allowed
If field 2.5 is populated with "false", this field shall be left blank

fields.name: Portfolio code
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unique code determined by the reporting counterparty identifying the portfolio.
fields.rule:
If the field 2.5 Cleared is populated with 'true' this field shall be populated and shall contain up to 52 alphanumerical characters. Four special characters are allowed ":", ".",  "-", " _" .  Special characters are not allowed at the beginning or the end.  No space allowed.
Otherwise it shall be left blank.

fields.name: Cleared
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Specifies that the contract has not been cleared.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall contain one of the values: 'true' or 'false'

fields.name: Trading venue
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the trading venue where the transaction was executed.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall contain a  MIC code included in the list maintained and updated by ISO and published at: http://www.iso15022.org/MIC/homepageMIC.htm (column "MIC" in table "MICs List by Country" of the respective Excel file).

fields.name: Master agreement type
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Reference to any master agreement, if existent (such as ISDA Master Agreement; Master Power Purchase and Sale Agreement; International ForEx Master Agreement; European Master Agreement or any local Master Agreements).
fields.rule: When populated, shall contain only one of the following values: "MRAA" , 'GMRA', 'MSLA' ,"GMSL", "ISDA', 'DERP', 'CNBR'. 'KRRA', 'CARA', 'FRFB', ' CHRA', 'DEMA', JPBR' , 'ESRA', 'OSLA', 'MEFI', 'GESL', 'KRSL', 'DERD'. 'JPBL', 'JPSL', 'BIAG', 'CSDA' or 'OTHR'.    4 alphabetical characters.

fields.name: Master agreement version
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU C, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Reference to the year of the master agreement version used for the reported trade, if applicable (such as 1992, 2002, etc).
fields.rule:
If field 2.9 is populated with a value different than 'BIAG', 'CSDA' or 'OTHR', this field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY. First two digits shall be "19" or "20". 
Otherwise, it shall be left blank.

fields.name: Other master agreement type
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU C, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Additional information specifying the other type of the master agreement.
fields.rule:
If field 2.9 is populated with 'OTHR', this field shall be populated and shall contain up to 50 alphanumeric characters. 
 'Otherwise, it shall be left blank.'

fields.name: Value date (Start date)
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Date on which the counterparties contractually agree the exchange of securities or commodities versus collateral for the opening leg (spot leg) of the secured financing transaction. In the case of rollover of transaction open term, this is the date on which the rollover settles, even if no exchange of cash takes place.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DD.
Value date shall be greater than or equal to the 2.12 Execution timestamp

fields.name: Minimum notice period
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Minimum number of business days that one of the counterparties has to inform about the termination of the transaction.
fields.rule:
If field 2.21 is populated with "true" or field 2.22 is populated with ‘EGRN’ or
‘ETSB,  this field shall be populated and shall contain an integer number equal to or greater than zero.
Up to 3 digits

fields.name: Earliest call-back date
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Earliest date that the cash lender has the right to call back a portion of the amount of money or to terminate the transaction.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: General collateral indicator
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indication whether the secured financing transaction is subject to a general or special collateral arrangement.
fields.rule:
If, for SL, field 2.73 is populated with 'true', or if  field 2.72 is populated with 'false' and field 2.75 is populated with 'SECU', this field shall be populated. Otherwise it shall be left blank.
When populated, shall contain only one of the following values: "SPEC" or 'GENE',   4 alphabetical characters.

fields.name: Delivery by Value ('DBV') indicator
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indicates whether the transaction was settled using the Delivery-by-Value (DBV) mechanism.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall contain one of the values: 'true' or 'false'

fields.name: Method used to provide collateral
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Delivery method of the collateral.
fields.rule:
If field 2.73 is populated with 'true', or if field 2.72 is populated with 'false'  and for SL field 2.75 is populated with 'SECU', this field shall be populated.
When populated, shall contain only one of the following values: "TTCA", 'SICA' or 'SIUR',   4 alphabetical characters.

fields.name: Open term
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Period before or at the end of which the loan should be repaid or renegotiated for another term.
fields.rule:
This field shall contain one of the values: 'true' or 'false'
If field 2.22 Termination optionality is populated with 'ETSB', this field shall be populated with 'false'

fields.name: Termination optionality
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indication whether the counterparties to the transaction have agreed to an evergreen or extendable agreement.
fields.rule: This field shall contain only one of the following values: "EGRN', 'ETSB' or 'NOAP'.

fields.name: Maturity date (End date)
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Date on which the counterparties contractually agree the exchange of securities or commodities versus collateral for the closing leg (forward leg) of the secured financing transaction.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DD.
For repos and SL, if the field 2.21 is populated with 'false', maturity date shall be populated, 
For repos, if the field 2.21 is populated with 'true', maturity date shall be left blank.
Maturity date shall be greater than or equal to the 2.13  Value date
When populated, for action types "MODI" and "CORR": the value in this field cannot be modified if the Event date (field 2.3) is earlier than 1 working day preceding the day of reporting (field 1.1)

fields.name: Termination optionality
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indication whether the counterparties to the transaction have agreed to an evergreen or extendable agreement.
fields.rule: This field shall contain only one of the following values: "EGRN', 'ETSB' or 'NOAP'.

fields.name: Fixed rate
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Annualised interest rate on the principal amount of the repurchase transaction in accordance with the day count convention.
fields.rule:
For repos and ML: one of the fields 2.23 Fixed rate or 2.25 Floating rate, shall be populated.
When populated, this field shall contain up to 11 numerical characters including up to 10 decimals. 
The decimal mark is not counted as a numerical character. If populated, it shall be represented with a  dot.
The negative symbol, if populated, shall not be counted as a numerical character.

fields.name: Day count convention
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Method for calculating the accrued interest on the principal amount for a fixed rate.
fields.rule:
If field 2.23 Fixed rate or 2.25 Floating rate is populated, this field shall be populated.
When populated, the field shall contain
-only one of the following values: "A001', 'A002', 'A003', 'A004', 'A005', 'A006', 'A007', A008', 'A009', A010', 'A011', 'A012'. 'A013' or 'A014'. 4 alphanumeric characters
or
-up to 35 alphanumeric characters

fields.name: Floating rate
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identifies the reference index for the debt instrument.
fields.rule:
For repos and ML: one of the fields 2.23 Fixed rate or 2.25 Floating rate, shall be populated.
When populated, the field shall contain
-only one of the following values: "EONA'. 'EONS', 'EURI', 'EUUS', 'EUCH', 'GCFR'. 'ISDA', 'LIBI', 'LIBO', 'MAAA', 'PFAN', 'TIBO', 'STBO', 'BBSW', 'JIBA', BUBO', 'CDOR', 'CIBO'. 'MOSP', 'NIBO'. 'PRBO', 'TLBO' , ' WIBO', 'TREA', 'SWAP' or 'FUSW'. 4 alphabetic characters
or
-up to 25 alphanumeric characters

fields.name: Floating rate reference period - time period
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unit for the rate basis.
fields.rule:
If field 2.25 Floating rate is populated, this field shall be populated and shall contain only one of the following values: "YEAR", "MNTH", WEEK" or "DAYS". 4 alphabetic characters.
Otherwise the field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Floating rate reference period - multiplier
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Value of the contract term in number of units.
fields.rule:
If field 2.25 Floating rate is populated, this field shall be populated and shall contain up to 3 numerical characters.
Otherwise the field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Floating rate payment
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)

fields.guidance: Value of the contract term in number of units.
fields.rule:

Otherwise the field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Spread
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indicates a margin, over or under an index, which determines a price or a rate for each leg of a derivative transaction with periodic payments; or a difference between two floating leg indexes.
fields.rule:
If field 2.25 Floating rate is populated, this field shall be populated and shall contain up to 5 numerical characters.
The negative symbol, if populated, shall not be counted as a numerical character.
Otherwise the field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Adjusted rate
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Specifies the rate as determined by the rate schedule.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall contain up to 11 numeric characters including up to 10 decimals. The decimal mark is not counted as a numeric character. If populated, it shall be represented with a dot.
The negative symbol, if populated, shall not be counted as a numerical character.

fields.name: Rate date
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Specifies date as of which the rate is effective.
fields.rule:
If field 2.35 is populated, this field shall be popluated. in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DD.
Otherwise it shall be left blank.

fields.name: Day count convention
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Method for calculating the accrued interest on the principal amount for a fixed rate.
fields.rule:
If field 2.23 Fixed rate or 2.25 Floating rate is populated, this field shall be populated.
When populated, the field shall contain
-only one of the following values: "A001', 'A002', 'A003', 'A004', 'A005', 'A006', 'A007', A008', 'A009', A010', 'A011', 'A012'. 'A013' or 'A014'. 4 alphanumeric characters
or

fields.name: Principal amount currency

fields.rule: When populated, shall contain only one of the following values: "SLEB" , 'SBSC', 'REPO' or "MGLD", " 4 alphabetical character.

fields.name: Unique Transaction Identifier ('UTI')
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU O, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unique trade Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.
fields.rule:
For Repo, BSB and SL when action type = COLU, this field shall be populated when 2.73 = 'false'.
When populated, this field shall contain up to 52 alphanumerical characters. 
Only upper-case alphabetic characters A–Z and the digits 0–9, inclusive in both cases, are allowed
Not allowed to change the content of this field once it is reported. 
The uniqueness of the Trade ID shall be preserved at counterparties level, i.e. the combination of the fields Counterparty ID- ID of the other counterparty-Trade ID shall be unique.

fields.name: Event date
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Date on which the reportable event pertaining to the transaction and captured by the report took place.
fields.rule:
This field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DD.
The date populated in this field shall be:
- prior or equal to the date part of the reporting timestamp
- greater than or equal to the date part of the execution timestamp.
-prior  or equal to the value of the field maturity date or, where populated, the termination date

fields.name: Execution timestamp
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indicates the date and time when the contract was executed.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

fields.name: Cleared
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indicates that the contract has been cleared.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall contain one of the values: 'true' or 'false'

fields.name: CCP
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: In the case of a contract that has been cleared, the unique code for the clearing counterparty that has cleared the contract.
fields.rule:
If field 2.5 is populated with 'true' this field shall be populated with a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued", "Lapsed",  "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch.
If field 2.5 is populated with "false", this field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Clearing timestamp
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Time and date when clearing took place.
fields.rule:
If field 2.5 is populated with 'true' this field shall be populated in a common input format:  YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. 
The value of this field shall be greater than or equal to the value of the field 2.12.
If field 2.5 is populated with "false", this field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Report tracking number
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unique number to indicate a group of reports which relate to the same execution.
fields.rule:
If field 2.5 is populated with 'true' and field 1.3 Reporting Counterparty is different from the field 2.7 CCP, this field shall be populated
When populated, this field shall contain up to 52 alphanumerical characters. 
Only upper-case alphabetic characters A–Z and the digits 0–9, inclusive in both cases, are allowed
If field 2.5 is populated with "false", this field shall be left blank

fields.name: Portfolio code
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unique code determined by the reporting counterparty identifying the portfolio.
fields.rule:
If the field 2.5 Cleared is populated with 'true' this field shall be populated and shall contain up to 52 alphanumerical characters. Four special characters are allowed ":", ".",  "-", " _" .  Special characters are not allowed at the beginning or the end.  No space allowed.
Otherwise it shall be left blank.

In the case of rollover of open term transactions, this is the date on which the rollover settles, even if no exchange of cash takes place.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DD.
Value date shall be greater than or equal to the 2.12 Execution timestamp

fields.name: Maturity date (End date)
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Date on which the counterparties contractually agree the exchange of securities or commodities versus collateral for the closing leg (forward leg) of the transaction.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DD.
For repos and SL, if the field 2.21 is populated with 'false', maturity date shall be populated, 
For repos, if the field 2.21 is populated with 'true', maturity date shall be left blank.
Maturity date shall be greater than or equal to the 2.13  Value date
When populated, for action types "MODI" and "CORR": the value in this field cannot be modified if the Event date (field 2.3) is earlier than 1 working day preceding the day of reporting (field 1.1)

fields.rule:

The first report received for given UTI and pair of counterparties shall only contain value "NEWT" or "POSC" in this field. If the first report for a given UTI and pair of counterparties is with action types "MODI", "VALU", "COLU", "EROR", "CORR"  or "ETRM" it shall be rejected.
Only one report with the action type "NEWT" for a given combination of Counterparty ID- ID of the other counterparty-Trade ID  shall be accepted. 
After a report with action type "EROR" is submitted, the only allowed action type to be submitted by the other counterparty, if reporting to the same TR, is "EROR". No additional reports shall be allowed for that UTI. 
The action types ETRM and POSC can only be reported once for a given UTI and pair of counterparties

fields.name: Reporting timestamp
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Date and time of submission of the report to the trade repository.
fields.rule:
This fiield shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:MM:SSZ '-
The reporting timestamp should be equal or earlier than the timestamp of the receipt of the report by the TR. The date part of the timestamp cannot be earlier than the day preceding the date of the receipt of the report by the TR.
The receipt of the report should be understood as the moment the report enters a TR’s system

fields.name: Report submitting entity
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unique code identifying the entity which submits the report. In the case where submission of the report has been delegated to a third party or to the other counterparty, a unique code identifying that entity.
fields.rule:
For action types 'NEWT', 'MODI', 'VALU', 'COLU','ETRM', 'CORR', or ' POSC'.": This field shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued", "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival". The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch.
For action type EROR: This field shall contain an LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit, irrespective of the registration status of that LEI.

fields.name: Reporting counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the counterparty in the transaction.
fields.rule:
For action types 'NEWT', 'MODI', 'VALU', 'COLU', 'CORR', or ' POSC'. This field shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit.  The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch. 
The status of the LEI for all the above action types shall be "Issued", "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival" and in addition for action type "ETRM": the status of the LEI could also  be "Lapsed" and "Retired".
For action type "EROR": This field shall contain an LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit, irrespective of the registration status of that LEI.

fields.name: Nature of the reporting counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Nature of the reporting counterparty in accordance with the local regulation.
fields.rule: Shall contain only one of the following values: "F" or "N".

fields.name: Sector of the reporting counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Classification of the business activities of the reporting counterparty.
fields.rule:
If field 4 is populated with "F", at least one code pertaining to the classification of the financial counterparties shall be provided.
If field 4 is populated with "N", at least one code pertaining to the classification of the non-financial counterparties shall be provided.

fields.name: Additional sector classification
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR - C, ETRM - C, POSC C, COLU - C, CORR C, VALU - C (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Nature business activities of the reporting counterparty as an investment fund.
fields.rule:
If field 5 is populated with 'UCIT', 'AIFD', 'K' or 'L', this field shall be populated and shall contain only one of the following values: 'ETFT', 'MMFT', REIT' or ' OTHR'. 4 alphabetical characters.
Otherwise, it shall be left bank.

fields.name: Sector of the reporting counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Classification of the business activities of the reporting counterparty.
fields.rule:
If field 4 is populated with "F", at least one code pertaining to the classification of the financial counterparties shall be provided.
If field 4 is populated with "N", at least one code pertaining to the classification of the non-financial counterparties shall be provided.

fields.name: Additional sector classification
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR - C, ETRM - C, POSC C, COLU - C, CORR C, VALU - C (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Nature business activities of the reporting counterparty as an investment fund.
fields.rule:
If field 5 is populated with 'UCIT', 'AIFD', 'K' or 'L', this field shall be populated and shall contain only one of the following values: 'ETFT', 'MMFT', REIT' or ' OTHR'. 4 alphabetical characters.
Otherwise, it shall be left bank.

fields.name: Branch of the reporting counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU O, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the branch of the counterparty, when the transaction concludes a transaction through a branch office.
fields.rule: When populated, shall contain a valid ISO 3166 country code,  2 alphabetical characters.

fields.name: Counterparty side
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identifies whether the reporting counterparty is a collateral provider or a collateral taker.
fields.rule: This field shall contain only one of the following values: "TAKE" or "GIVE", " 4 alphabetical characters.

fields.name: Other counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the counterparty in the transaction.
fields.rule:
This field shall contain
- a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch. The LEI shall not pertain to a member of the European System of Central Banks (ESCB). For action types "NEWT", "MODI", "ETRM", "CORR", "COLU", "VALU" and "POSC": The status of the LEI shall be "Issued", "Lapsed", "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival" and in addition for action type "ETRM" the status of the LEI could also  be "Retired".
For action type "EROR": This field shall contain an LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit, irrespective of the registration status of that LEI.
or
-up to 50 alphanumerical characters

fields.name: Branch of the other counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU O, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the branch of the counterparty, when the transaction concludes a transaction through a branch office.
fields.rule: When populated, shall contain a valid ISO 3166 country code,  2 alphabetical characters.

fields.name: Country of the other Counterparty
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Country where the registered office of the counterparty is located or country of residence in case that the counterparty is a natural person.
fields.rule:
2 alphabetical characters.
If field 11  is populated with a valid LEI, then the country code provided in this field shall pertain to the country of the registered office of the other counterparty as specified in the LEI reference data.         In case that the other counterparty is a natural person, the code of the country of residence.

fields.name: Entity responsible for the report
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: In the case where a financial counterparty is responsible for reporting on behalf of the other counterparty, the unique code identifying that counterparty. In the case where a management company is responsible for reporting on behalf of an Undertaking for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS), the unique code identifying that management company. In the case where an Alternative Investment Fund Manager (AIFM) is responsible for reporting on behalf of an Alternative Investment Fund (AIF), the unique code identifying that AIFM.
fields.rule:
This field shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch. 
The status of the LEI for all the above action types shall be "Issued", "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival" and in addition for action types "ETRM" and "EROR": the status of the LEI could also  be "Lapsed" and "Retired".

fields.name: Beneficiary
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU -, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the beneficiary who is subject to the rights and obligations arising from the contract.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall contain:
- a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued", 'Lapsed', "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch.
or
-up to 50 alphanumerical characters where any character is allowed.

fields.name: Tri-party agent
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU O, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the third party that administers the transaction.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued",  'Lapsed', "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch.

fields.name: Broker
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU -, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the broker involved in the securities lending transaction.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued",  'Lapsed', "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch.

fields.name: Clearing member
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the clearing member in the case where the trade is cleared.
fields.rule:
If field 2.5 is populated with 'true'  this field shall be populated
When populated, shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued", "Lapsed", "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch.
If field 2.5 is populated with 'false', this field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Central Securities Depository (‘CSD’) participant or indirect participant
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU -, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the parties settling the contract on behalf of the deliverer or receiver.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued",  'Lapsed', "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch

fields.name: Agent lender
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU O, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the agent lender involved in the securities lending transaction.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued",  'Lapsed', "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch

fields.name: Type of SFT
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Details of the repurchase trade transaction.
fields.rule: When populated, shall contain only one of the following values: "SLEB" , 'SBSC', 'REPO' or "MGLD", " 4 alphabetical character.

fields.name: Unique Transaction Identifier ('UTI')
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU O, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unique Trade Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.
fields.rule:
For Repo, BSB and SL when action type = COLU, this field shall be populated when 2.73 = 'false'.
When populated, this field shall contain up to 52 alphanumerical characters. 
Only upper-case alphabetic characters A–Z and the digits 0–9, inclusive in both cases, are allowed
Not allowed to change the content of this field once it is reported. 
The uniqueness of the Trade ID shall be preserved at counterparties level, i.e. the combination of the fields Counterparty ID- ID of the other counterparty-Trade ID shall be unique.

fields.name: Event date
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Date on which the reportable event pertaining to the transaction and captured by the report took place.
fields.rule:
This field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DD.
The date populated in this field shall be:
- prior or equal to the date part of the reporting timestamp
- greater than or equal to the date part of the execution timestamp.
-prior  or equal to the value of the field maturity date or, where populated, the termination date

fields.name: Execution timestamp
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indicates the date and time when the contract was executed.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

fields.name: Cleared
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indicates that the contract has been cleared.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall contain one of the values: 'true' or 'false'

fields.name: CCP
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: In the case of a contract that has been cleared, the unique code for the clearing counterparty that has cleared the contract.
fields.rule:
If field 2.5 is populated with 'true' this field shall be populated with a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued", "Lapsed",  "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch.
If field 2.5 is populated with "false", this field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Clearing timestamp
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Time and date when clearing took place.
fields.rule:
If field 2.5 is populated with 'true' this field shall be populated in a common input format:  YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. 
The value of this field shall be greater than or equal to the value of the field 2.12.
If field 2.5 is populated with "false", this field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Report tracking number
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unique number to indicate a group of reports which relate to the same execution.
fields.rule:
If field 2.5 is populated with 'true' and field 1.3 Reporting Counterparty is different from the field 2.7 CCP, this field shall be populated
When populated, this field shall contain up to 52 alphanumerical characters. 
Only upper-case alphabetic characters A–Z and the digits 0–9, inclusive in both cases, are allowed
If field 2.5 is populated with "false", this field shall be left blank

fields.name: Cleared
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Specifies that the contract has not been cleared.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall contain one of the values: 'true' or 'false'

fields.name: Trading venue
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identification of the trading venue where the transaction was executed.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall contain a  MIC code included in the list maintained and updated by ISO and published at: http://www.iso15022.org/MIC/homepageMIC.htm (column "MIC" in table "MICs List by Country" of the respective Excel file).

fields.name: Master agreement type
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Reference to any master agreement, if existent (such as ISDA Master Agreement; Master Power Purchase and Sale Agreement; International ForEx Master Agreement; European Master Agreement or any local Master Agreements).
fields.rule: When populated, shall contain only one of the following values: "MRAA" , 'GMRA', 'MSLA' ,"GMSL", "ISDA', 'DERP', 'CNBR'. 'KRRA', 'CARA', 'FRFB', ' CHRA', 'DEMA', JPBR' , 'ESRA', 'OSLA', 'MEFI', 'GESL', 'KRSL', 'DERD'. 'JPBL', 'JPSL', 'BIAG', 'CSDA' or 'OTHR'.    4 alphabetical characters.

fields.name: Master agreement version
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU C, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Reference to the year of the master agreement version used for the reported trade, if applicable (such as 1992, 2002, etc).
fields.rule:
If field 2.9 is populated with a value different than 'BIAG', 'CSDA' or 'OTHR', this field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY. First two digits shall be "19" or "20". 
Otherwise, it shall be left blank.

fields.name: Other master agreement type
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU C, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Additional information specifying the other type of the master agreement.
fields.rule:
If field 2.9 is populated with 'OTHR', this field shall be populated and shall contain up to 50 alphanumeric characters. 
 'Otherwise, it shall be left blank.'

fields.name: Value date (Start date)
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Date on which the counterparties contractually agree the exchange of securities or commodities versus collateral for the opening leg (spot leg) of the secured financing transaction. In the case of rollover of transaction open term, this is the date on which the rollover settles, even if no exchange of cash takes place.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DD.
Value date shall be greater than or equal to the 2.12 Execution timestamp

fields.name: Minimum notice period
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Minimum number of business days that one of the counterparties has to inform about the termination of the transaction.
fields.rule:
If field 2.21 is populated with "true" or field 2.22 is populated with ‘EGRN’ or
‘ETSB,  this field shall be populated and shall contain an integer number equal to or greater than zero.
Up to 3 digits

fields.name: Earliest call-back date
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Earliest date that the cash lender has the right to call back a portion of the amount of money or to terminate the transaction.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: General collateral indicator
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indication whether the secured financing transaction is subject to a general or special collateral arrangement.
fields.rule:
If, for SL, field 2.73 is populated with 'true', or if  field 2.72 is populated with 'false' and field 2.75 is populated with 'SECU', this field shall be populated. Otherwise it shall be left blank.
When populated, shall contain only one of the following values: "SPEC" or 'GENE',   4 alphabetical characters.

fields.name: Delivery by Value ('DBV') indicator
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indicates whether the transaction was settled using the Delivery-by-Value (DBV) mechanism.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall contain one of the values: 'true' or 'false'

fields.name: Method used to provide collateral
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Delivery method of the collateral.
fields.rule:
If field 2.73 is populated with 'true', or if field 2.72 is populated with 'false'  and for SL field 2.75 is populated with 'SECU', this field shall be populated.
When populated, shall contain only one of the following values: "TTCA", 'SICA' or 'SIUR',   4 alphabetical characters.

fields.name: Open term
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Period before or at the end of which the loan should be repaid or renegotiated for another term.
fields.rule:
This field shall contain one of the values: 'true' or 'false'
If field 2.22 Termination optionality is populated with 'ETSB', this field shall be populated with 'false'

fields.name: Termination optionality
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indication whether the counterparties to the transaction have agreed to an evergreen or extendable agreement.
fields.rule: This field shall contain only one of the following values: "EGRN', 'ETSB' or 'NOAP'.

fields.name: Maturity date (End date)
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Date on which the counterparties contractually agree the exchange of securities or commodities versus collateral for the closing leg (forward leg) of the secured financing transaction.
fields.rule:
When populated, this field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DD.
For repos and SL, if the field 2.21 is populated with 'false', maturity date shall be populated, 
For repos, if the field 2.21 is populated with 'true', maturity date shall be left blank.
Maturity date shall be greater than or equal to the 2.13  Value date
When populated, for action types "MODI" and "CORR": the value in this field cannot be modified if the Event date (field 2.3) is earlier than 1 working day preceding the day of reporting (field 1.1)

fields.name: Termination optionality
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indication whether the counterparties to the transaction have agreed to an evergreen or extendable agreement.
fields.rule: This field shall contain only one of the following values: "EGRN', 'ETSB' or 'NOAP'.

fields.name: Fixed rate
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Annualised interest rate on the principal amount of the repurchase transaction in accordance with the day count convention.
fields.rule:
For repos and ML: one of the fields 2.23 Fixed rate or 2.25 Floating rate, shall be populated.
When populated, this field shall contain up to 11 numerical characters including up to 10 decimals. 
The decimal mark is not counted as a numerical character. If populated, it shall be represented with a  dot.
The negative symbol, if populated, shall not be counted as a numerical character.

fields.name: Day count convention
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Method for calculating the accrued interest on the principal amount for a fixed rate.
fields.rule:
If field 2.23 Fixed rate or 2.25 Floating rate is populated, this field shall be populated.
When populated, the field shall contain
-only one of the following values: "A001', 'A002', 'A003', 'A004', 'A005', 'A006', 'A007', A008', 'A009', A010', 'A011', 'A012'. 'A013' or 'A014'. 4 alphanumeric characters
or
-up to 35 alphanumeric characters

fields.name: Floating rate
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Identifies the reference index for the debt instrument.
fields.rule:
For repos and ML: one of the fields 2.23 Fixed rate or 2.25 Floating rate, shall be populated.
When populated, the field shall contain
-only one of the following values: "EONA'. 'EONS', 'EURI', 'EUUS', 'EUCH', 'GCFR'. 'ISDA', 'LIBI', 'LIBO', 'MAAA', 'PFAN', 'TIBO', 'STBO', 'BBSW', 'JIBA', BUBO', 'CDOR', 'CIBO'. 'MOSP', 'NIBO'. 'PRBO', 'TLBO' , ' WIBO', 'TREA', 'SWAP' or 'FUSW'. 4 alphabetic characters
or
-up to 25 alphanumeric characters

fields.name: Floating rate reference period - time period
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unit for the rate basis.
fields.rule:
If field 2.25 Floating rate is populated, this field shall be populated and shall contain only one of the following values: "YEAR", "MNTH", WEEK" or "DAYS". 4 alphabetic characters.
Otherwise the field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Floating rate reference period - multiplier
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Value of the contract term in number of units.
fields.rule:
If field 2.25 Floating rate is populated, this field shall be populated and shall contain up to 3 numerical characters.
Otherwise the field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Floating rate payment
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unit for the rate basis.
fields.rule:
If field 2.25 Floating rate is populated, this field shall be  populated, and shall contain only one of the following values: "YEAR", "MNTH", WEEK" or "DAYS". 4 alphabetic characters.
Otherwise the field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Floating rate payment
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Value of the contract term in number of units.
fields.rule:
If field 2.25 Floating rate is populated, this field shall be populated, and shall contain up to 3 numerical characters.
Otherwise the field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Floating rate reset
fields.obligation: NEWT -, MODI -, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC -, COLU -, CORR -, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unit for the rate basis.
fields.rule:

If field 2.40 is populated with 'SECU', this field shall be populated with CFI code composed of 6 characters and compliant with ISO 10962 Standard. At least the first  2 characters of the CFI code and the character representing asset class (if applicable for a given instrument)  shall be provided (ie. these characters cannot be "X",  which represents not applicable or undefined value). 
Otherwise, it shall be left blank.

fields.name: Quantity or nominal amount
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Quantity or nominal amount of the security or commodity subject of the transaction.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall contain up to 18 numeric characters including up to 5 decimals. The decimal mark is not counted as a numeric character. If populated, it shall be represented with a dot.

fields.name: Currency of nominal amount
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU -, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Medium of exchange of currency.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall contain ISO 4217 Currency Code (official list only), 3 alphabetical characters.

fields.name: Security or commodity price
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC M, COLU -, CORR M, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Price of unit of collateral component, including accrued interest for interest-bearing securities, used to value the security.
fields.rule:
When  populated, this field shall contain up to 18 numeric characters including up to 5 decimals or up to 11 numeric characters including up to 10 decimals The decimal mark is not counted as a numeric character. If populated, it shall be represented with a dot.
The negative symbol, if populated, shall not be counted as a numerical character.

fields.name: Price currency
fields.obligation: NEWT O, MODI O, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC O, COLU -, CORR O, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Medium of exchange of currency.
fields.rule: When populated, this field shall contain ISO 4217 Currency Code (official list only), 3 alphabetical characters.

fields.name: Security quality
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Code that classifies the risk of the security.
fields.rule:
If field 2.40 is populated with 'SECU', this field shall be populated and shall contain only one of the following values: 'INVG', 'NIVG' , 'NOTR' or 'NOAP'. 4 alphabetic characters.
 If field 2.40 is populated with 'COMM' this field shall be left blank

fields.name: Maturity of the security
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Maturity date of the security.
fields.rule:
If field 2.40 is populated with 'SECU' , this field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DD.
When maturity date is not applicable use default code 9999-12-31.

fields.name: LEI of the issuer
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Legal entity identification of the issuer of the security.
fields.rule:
If field 2.40 is populated with 'SECU' and field 2.53 is populated with a country code pertaining to an EEA country, this field shall be populated and  shall contain a valid LEI included in the GLEIF database maintained by the Central Operating Unit. The LEI shall pertain to a legal entity and not a branch. The status of the LEI shall be "Issued",  'Lapsed', "Pending transfer" or "Pending archival".
If field 2.40 is populated with 'COMM', this field shall be left blank.

fields.name: Jurisdiction of the issuer
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Jurisdiction of the issuer of the security used as collateral. In case of securities issued by a foreign subsidiary, the jurisdiction of the ultimate parent company shall be reported or, if not known, jurisdiction of the subsidiary.
fields.rule:
If field 2.40 is populated with 'SECU' this field shall be populated and shall contain a valid ISO 3166 country code,  2 alphabetical characters.
Otherwise it shall be left blank.

fields.name: Security type
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Classification of the type of the security.
fields.rule:
If field 2.40 is populated with 'SECU' this field shall be populated and shall contain only one of the following values: 'GOVS', 'SUNS', 'FIDE', 'NFID', 'SEPR', 'MEQU', 'OEQU'  or 'OTHR'. 4 alphabetic characters
Otherwise it shall be left blank.

fields.name: Exclusive arrangements
fields.obligation: NEWT C, MODI C, EROR -, ETRM -, POSC C, COLU -, CORR C, VALU - (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indication whether the borrower has exclusive access to borrow from the lender's securities portfolio.
fields.rule:

When populated, this field shall contain one of the values: 'true' or 'false'

fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU O, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Unique trade Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.
fields.rule:
For Repo, BSB and SL when action type = COLU, this field shall be populated when 2.73 = 'false'.
When populated, this field shall contain up to 52 alphanumerical characters. 
Only upper-case alphabetic characters A–Z and the digits 0–9, inclusive in both cases, are allowed
Not allowed to change the content of this field once it is reported. 
The uniqueness of the Trade ID shall be preserved at counterparties level, i.e. the combination of the fields Counterparty ID- ID of the other counterparty-Trade ID shall be unique.

fields.rule:
This field shall be populated in a common input format: YYYY-MM-DD.
The date populated in this field shall be:
- prior or equal to the date part of the reporting timestamp
- greater than or equal to the date part of the execution timestamp.
-prior  or equal to the value of the field maturity date or, where populated, the termination date

fields.name: Action type
fields.obligation: NEWT M, MODI M, EROR M, ETRM M, POSC M, COLU M, CORR M, VALU M (securities lending)
fields.guidance: Indicates whether transaction was reported by mistake and needs to be removed.
fields.rule:
This field shall contain only one of the following values: 'NEWT', 'MODI', VALU', 'COLU', 'EROR', 'CORR', 'ETRM' or ' POSC'. 4 alphabetical characters.
The first report received for given UTI and pair of counterparties shall only contain value "NEWT" or "POSC" in this field. If the first report for a given UTI and pair of counterparties is with action types "MODI", "VALU", "COLU", "EROR", "CORR"  or "ETRM" it shall be rejected.
Only one report with the action type "NEWT" for a given combination of Counterparty ID- ID of the other counterparty-Trade ID  shall be accepted. 
After a report with action type "EROR" is submitted, the only allowed action type to be submitted by the other counterparty, if reporting to the same TR, is "EROR". No additional reports shall be allowed for that UTI. 
The action types ETRM and POSC can only be reported once for a given UTI and pair of counterparties
